summary: Iteration 13: focused testing of the WhatsApp confirmation/reminder feature (booking with email, wa.me links, admin confirmar/recordatorio, cron endpoint + e2e email) and verification of the Home #ubicacion maps_query fix. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (new /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_whatsapp.py). Frontend: mobile booking e2e (390x844) reached success screen with correct wa.me link and no barber button; admin agenda flow (badge Pendiente -> Confirmar -> Confirmada verde, boton Confirmar desaparece, Recordatorio abre wa.me correcto via window.open intercept) all passed. One real (intermittent) UI defect found: the Google Maps iframe keeps showing the fallback 'Tenerife' map even though its src attribute is correctly updated to the maps_query.

minor.issue: run_recordatorios is not concurrency-safe: it reads the pending list first and marks recordatorio_enviado per appointment afterwards. Two overlapping cron calls processed the same 3 appointments and sent 4 emails (logs 02:11:09 show 'Recordatorios: 3 citas procesadas' twice). Use an atomic find_one_and_update({id, recordatorio_enviado: {$ne: true}}) claim before sending.
Public/unauthenticated and returns client_phone + client_email (PII) for any known appointment id. Pre-existing, but worth restricting or requiring phone match.

ui_bugs.issue: Iframe mounts before /api/business resolves with the fallback query ('Tenerife, España'); when business.maps_query arrives React updates the src attribute (verified src contains Multitienda%20Veloz%2024hr) but the already-loaded Google embed does NOT re-navigate, so the visible map shows the generic Tenerife island instead of Multitienda Veloz 24hr. Reproduced in 2 of 3 loads, still wrong after 12s. Fix: render the iframe only when business.maps_query is loaded, or add key={business.maps_query} to force a remount.

design_issues.screen: Booking step 3 (no slots day, e.g. Sunday 30/08)
issues: 'Siguiente' stays visually enabled with 0 slots; clicking shows toast 'Elige una hora' (acceptable, but could be disabled), and the empty state leaves a very large blank area below on mobile

action_items: Fix the Google Maps iframe not re-navigating when business.maps_query loads (key or conditional render) — the 'Abrir en Maps' link and the src attribute are already correct.
Make run_recordatorios atomic per appointment to avoid duplicate reminder emails on overlapping cron runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx: iframe src is derived from async state; iframes with a src changed after load are unreliable — use key={business.maps_query || 'loading'} or defer render.
server.py run_recordatorios: claim-then-send pattern needed (find_one_and_update with recordatorio_enviado filter) for idempotency; cron providers retry.
server.py is 694 lines and mixes email safety, cron, business, appointments — consider splitting into routers/modules soon.

rca_of_the_issue: Maps: Home.jsx renders <iframe src={maps?q=<business.maps_query || fallback>}> on first paint while business state is still {}. Once /api/business resolves, React patches the src attribute of the mounted iframe; the Google Maps embed (already loaded with the fallback 'Tenerife, España' query) does not re-navigate, so the user keeps seeing the wrong map even though DOM/attribute assertions pass. Reproduction: load /, scroll to #ubicacion, wait 12s — src contains Multitienda but the rendered map shows the Tenerife island. Mitigation: key the iframe on maps_query or render it only after business loads.
